```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = TRUE,     # show code
  eval = TRUE,     # execute code
  error = TRUE,    # show errors (and keep knitting)
  warning = TRUE,  # show warnings
  message = TRUE,   # show messages (e.g., package startup)
  collapse = TRUE,  # show code + output together
  comment = "#>"    # prefix output like reprex
)

source(here::here("scripts", "00_setup.R"))

data_proc_rel <- cfg_get("paths.data_proc", "data_proc")
p_data_proc <- here::here(data_proc_rel)
p_derived <- file.path(p_data_proc, "derived")

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(readr)
library(viridis)
```

## 1) Cube totals by basisOfRecord

```{r}
totals <- read_csv(file.path(p_data_proc, "cube_totals_by_basisOfRecord.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)

totals
totals %>%
  arrange(desc(total_occurrences)) %>%
  print(n = 50)
```

```{r}
ggplot(totals, aes(x = basisOfRecord, y = total_occurrences)) +
  geom_col() +
  coord_flip() +
  facet_wrap(~ grid, scales = "free_x") +
  labs(
    title = "Total occurrences by basisOfRecord (per grid)",
    x = "basisOfRecord",
    y = "Total occurrences"
  )

```


 
```{r}

totals_noHumObs <- totals %>%
  filter(basisOfRecord != "humanObservation")

ggplot(totals_noHumObs, aes(x = basisOfRecord, y = total_occurrences)) +
  geom_col() +
  coord_flip() +
  facet_wrap(~ grid, scales = "free_x") +
  labs(
    title = "Total occurrences by basisOfRecord (per grid)",
    x = "basisOfRecord",
    y = "Total occurrences" )

```

## 3) Temporal sanity: time trend

This section assumes that `yearmonth` is encoded as `YYYYMM` (e.g., `202312`).
If your format is different, adjust the parsing.

```{r}
time10 <- read_csv(file.path(p_derived, "time_summary_10km.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  filter(basisofrecord == "all")

time10 <- time10 %>%
  mutate(
    yearmonth_chr = stringr::str_trim(as.character(yearmonth)),
    year = as.integer(substr(yearmonth_chr, 1, 4)),
    month = as.integer(substr(yearmonth_chr, 6, 7)),
    ym = as.Date(paste0(yearmonth_chr, "-01"))
  )


ggplot(time10, aes(x = ym, y = occurrences)) +
  geom_line() +
  labs(x = "Year-Month", y = "Occurrences")

```
### 3.1 Plot by Year

```{r}
time10_year <- time10 %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  summarise(occurrences = sum(occurrences, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

ggplot(time10_year, aes(x = year, y = occurrences)) +
  geom_line() +
  labs(x = "Year", y = "Occurrences", title = "Occurrences per year (10km, all)")
```
### 3.2 Plot by Month

```{r}
time10_month <- time10 %>%
  group_by(month) %>%
  summarise(occurrences = sum(occurrences, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

ggplot(time10_month, aes(x = month, y = occurrences)) +
  geom_line() +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:12, limits = c(1, 12)) +
  labs(x = "Month", y = "Occurrences", title = "Occurrences per year (10km, all)")
```

### 3.3 Heatmap

```{r}
time10_heat <- time10 %>%
  group_by(year, month) %>%
  summarise(occurrences = sum(occurrences, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

ggplot(time10_heat, aes(x = month, y = year, fill = occurrences)) +
  geom_tile() +
  scale_fill_viridis() +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:12) +
  labs(x = "Month", y = "Year", title = "Sampling intensity by year and month")


time10_heat_last50yrs <- time10 %>%
  filter(year > 1974) %>%
  group_by(year, month) %>%
  summarise(occurrences = sum(occurrences, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

ggplot(time10_heat_last50yrs, aes(x = month, y = year, fill = occurrences)) +
  geom_tile() +
  scale_fill_viridis() +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:12) +
  labs(x = "Month", y = "Year", title = "Sampling intensity by year and month")
```
